rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (3 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/32462778-My-Chemical-Romance-The-Mad-Gear-And-Missile-Kid, https://www.last.fm/music/My+Chemical+Romance/The+Mad+Gear+and+Missile+Kid+EP. Exclusive 3-track EP by MCR's fictional alter-ego band, released November 22, 2010. Originally bundled with the limited (5000-copy) Danger Days: The True Lives of the Fabulous Killjoys California 2019 Edition box set; released to streaming services August 2022. First and only MCR release featuring Michael Pedicone on drums.
